newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Phil Estates to build bayside condo.
newsitem.headline: Phil Estates to build bayside condo.

text.p: Philippine Estates Corp said on Tuesday it had forged a joint venture with unlisted Pearl of the Orient Realty & Development to build a high-rise condominium in Manila.
Philippine Estates told the Philippine Stock Exchange that Pearl of the Orient would build a 42-storey residential and commercial condominium on its property facing the Manila Bay.
Philippine Estates is a smaller property company. Earlier, it said it was set to launch this year 12 diversified real estate projects ranging from industrial estates to country clubs.
